question: What three contemplations constitute the Shambhava means?
premises: One may contemplate that this arises from me.
One may contemplate that this is reflected in me alone.
One may contemplate that this is not different from me.
inference: The Shambhava means is articulated as a threefold contemplative recognition of source, reflection, and non-difference.
plain_english: This has arisen from me, this is reflected in me alone, and this is not different from me: in this threefold way is the Shambhava means.
